purpose: Independent practice of C3.1 (write IF-THEN code).
student_learning_goal: I can write IF-THEN code for a math situation.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can write IF-THEN code for a math situation.
header.character_watermark: Inspector If in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Match each condition with an action that fits. Draw a line.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Six condition-action match pairs.

image_placeholders.description: Six match pairs in B&W line-art, ~7in x 3in. Left column conditions: 'IF >10', 'IF even', 'IF rains', 'IF =5', 'IF Monday', 'IF score >50'. Right column actions: 'THEN say BIG', 'THEN clap', 'THEN umbrella', 'THEN star', 'THEN math class', 'THEN cheer'. Header 'Match:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P1_MATCH: keywords (match) name what the pairs ask for.

parts.student_instructions: Write IF-THEN code with TWO branches for each sorting task.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Four two-branch slot pairs.

image_placeholders.description: Four two-branch slot pairs in B&W line-art, ~7in x 3in. Each pair: 'Sort: ___', 'IF ___, THEN ___.', 'IF NOT ___, THEN ___.'. Pre-filled tasks: even/odd, big/small, multiple of 5/not, school day/weekend. Header 'Two Branches:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P2_TWO: keywords (branches) name what the slots ask for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Both branches must have a condition and action.

parts.student_instructions: Write 2 of your own two-branch IF-THENs.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. Two two-branch slot pairs.

image_placeholders.description: Two two-branch slot pairs in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2in. Each pair: 'IF ___, THEN ___. IF NOT ___, THEN ___.'. Header 'My Code:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P3_OWN: keywords (code) name what the slots ask for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Both branches must be present.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, swap with a partner and trace their code with 3 sample inputs.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 worksheet practices C3.1 writing. Watch for missing-branch trap — children who write only one branch.
